subject: Brightframe: marketplace ledger serialization mismatch & collection triage
messages:
From: Nicole Hart <nicole.hart@brightframe.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: acct@brightframe.io
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected invoice line + collection hold (Brightframe)

Hi Priyom,

We pulled our September marketplace invoice and noticed ~2 small clusters of charges that don't map to any of our usage windows — around 2028-08-31 22:00 UTC and 2028-09-02 03:00 UTC. That caused an overage that triggered an automated hold from our AP team; they've paused payment pending evidence.

Attached is the invoice PDF and our AP note asking for event-level lineage (original meter-event IDs, SKU mapping, and the marketplace transaction ID). Can your team provide a manifest we can share with our accounting team? AP needs the file by EOD Thursday (2028-09-28) or we'll have to push the payment to the next cycle.

Thanks,
Nicole Hart
Finance Manager — Brightframe
attachments: brightframe_invoice_Q3_2028.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Hart <nicole.hart@brightframe.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected invoice line + collection hold (Brightframe)

Hi Nicole — thank you for flagging this and sharing the AP note. I’m sorry for the hassle. I’ve pulled initial traces and we see an ingestion checkpoint mismatch during the AWS billing export for 2028-08-31 which can surface as duplicate or orphaned meter events.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- We’ll assemble an evidence manifest with original meter_event_ids, seller_sku, and marketplace_transaction_id for the two suspect windows.
- Marissa will pull the AWS/GCP raw event bundles and Jonas will validate the ledger serialization against our billing ledger.
- I’ll produce a compact CSV your AP team can ingest.

We’ll aim to send the manifest + attachments by EOD Wednesday (2028-09-27). If you need a formal attestation for AP, tell me and I’ll escalate to our finance ops.

Best,
Priyom
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightframe ledger serialization mismatch & collection triage

Priyom / Jonas — I exported the two raw bundles from our ingest S3 path and zipped the event sets. Quick findings: one bundle (aws-export-2028-08-31-22) has a duplicated meter_event_id batch that looks like it was replayed when the ingestion job retried after a transient Lambda timeout. The other (gcp-window-2028-09-02-03) shows a late-arrival aggregation where the pre-aggregation timestamp-zone normalization pushed events into the next UTC window and we double-counted when a backfill ran.

I attached a short evidence_manifest.csv with the following columns: meter_event_id, marketplace, raw_timestamp, ingest_job_id, ledger_row_id, seller_sku, marketplace_transaction_id. I also flagged rows with suspected duplication.

Action items I think we should include in the packet for Brightframe/AP:
- CSV manifest (attached) + short explanation of root cause for each flagged window.
- Raw event bundles (aws_meter_events_2028-08-31.json) as reference.
- Confirmation of remediation: we will adjust the ledger to remove duplicate ledger_row_id entries and issue a corrected invoice if necessary.

Attaching evidence_manifest.csv and aws_meter_events_2028-08-31.json to this thread.
attachments: evidence_manifest.csv, aws_meter_events_2028-08-31.json

-Marissa
Billing Systems Lead — Redwood Inference
From: aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com <aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Sep 2028 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request for raw meter_event_id lineage (Brightframe)

Hello Redwood team,

We received a request from Brightframe for the marketplace transaction IDs and meter_event_ids. We can provide the transaction logs for the date ranges you've identified, but to expedite we need the list of marketplace_transaction_id values or seller_sku filters. Please confirm the exact IDs or provide a bundle of suspect meter_event_ids and we’ll return the corresponding marketplace_transaction record with our internal reconciliation token.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Billing Support
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com, pri_yom.das@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 27 Sep 2028 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Request for raw meter_event_id lineage (Brightframe)

Hi — thanks for the quick reply. We’ve attached the subset of meter_event_ids that are flagged in the evidence_manifest.csv (see attached). Could you return the marketplace_transaction_id and the AWS reconciliation_token for each? Also please confirm if any of these events were marked as RETRIED or DUPLICATE on your side.

We are also including a short MD explaining our ingestion checkpoint mismatch and the ingest_job_id for traceability. If you can return the mapping CSV and any notes about duplicate markings, that will let us close the loop with Brightframe’s AP.

Attachments: flagged_meter_event_ids_subset.csv

—Jonas
Revenue Data Engineering — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Hart <nicole.hart@brightframe.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 Sep 2028 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightframe: marketplace ledger serialization mismatch & collection triage

Nicole — quick update and next steps for AP: we’ve attached an evidence packet (evidence_manifest.csv + raw event excerpts) that maps the suspect invoice lines to original meter_event_ids and notes where events are duplicates or late-arrivals. We are coordinating with AWS on marketplace_transaction_id mapping (ticket in progress).

Planned remediation and what to provide to AP:
- Immediate: evidence_manifest.csv (attached) and short one‑page explanation (included in Drive link) that you can attach to your payment file.
- If AP requires it: Redwood will issue a corrected invoice for any confirmed duplicate charges and provide an attestation letter.
- Internal follow-up: we will close BILL-9082 with a remediation verification checklist and deploy a fix to the checkpointing to prevent replayed batches.

Please confirm if AP accepts the CSV + Drive link as interim evidence and whether you want the attestation letter before the next cycle. We are prioritizing this to avoid payment delays.

Thanks — Priyom
